rows.text: Drinking and listening to music are the only two hobbies a Mythemian will have in their lives. Therefore, brewers and musicians are the most respected professions in that entire city. There was once a "person" who simultaneously reached the zenith of both crafts — It was a machine created by the Grand Craftsman Phionisius while in a drunken stupor. The machine once played enchanting melodies while brewing charming wine in a feast held by the king, and drowned all guests present in supreme bliss. However, the story had a tragic end. The king wished to claim the machine and therefore killed the craftsman, while the machine had grown attached to the craftsman and therefore poisoned the king. In the end, the royal guards tore that intricate machine to pieces.
